<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 1.48.0 -->

## What's Changed
### Breaking Changes 🛠
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width/height parameters to st.container and st.columns by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11468
### New Features 🎉
* Add column info to dataframe column menu by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11303
* Change button styles by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11964
* Make crossorigin property configurable for media elements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11948
* New design for `st.expander` and `st.status` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11995
* Option to have non dismissable dialog by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9504
* Make slider have standard height by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11986
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameter to `st.popover` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11799
* Add new spinner design by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12031
* Add support for rerunning app when dialog gets dismissed by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12034
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds a width parameters to button elements by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11719
* Make `codeFontWeight` separately configurable in sidebar by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12056
* [AdvancedLayouts] Adds direction, gap, horizontal and vertical alignment to `st.container` by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11887
### Bug Fixes 🐛
* Correctly reset chat input session state value by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11916
* Fix chart colors not applied in sidebar by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11917
* [fix] Make the topPadding also look to see if there's a sidebar so that it stays consistent by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11913
* [fix] flaky pydeck selection tests. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11954
* Make `st.feedback` correctly use hover color by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11981
* Fix pills and segmented control element ID by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11982
* Fix: Show correct widget name in button group error messages by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11769
* Hide quickselect in `date_input` if min date is more than 2 years ago by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11999
* Fix design of disabled states by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11989
* [fix] Sidebar toggle state reset on page resize.  by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12024
* Make `st.help` use bgMix for header color by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12032
* [fix] Add top navigation rendering logic based on page and section count by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12025
* Make st.logout use end_session_endpoint if provided in OIDC config by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11901
* Accept lists for callback args by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12039
* Tweak scrollbar handling by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11936
* Update altair dependency constraints in setup.py to exclude problematic versions 5.4.0 and 5.4.1 due to compatibility issues with the narwhals library. by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12066
* [Fix] Allow fractional heading font sizes by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12077
* [Fix] Configured `codeFontWeight` handles bold code font by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12074
* [fix] Make toolbar still show custom menu items when in MINIMAL mode by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12091
* [fix] Assign st.line_chart colors by assigned order, not alphabetically by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12092
* Fix stop signal issue on windows by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12049
### Other Changes
* Document file upload `type` as best-effort check by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11884
* Add optional dependencies as extras to streamlit package by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11760
* Release 1.47.0 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11935
* Fix confusing `no running event loop` logs by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12008
* Release/1.47.1 by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12033
* Fix vega themes deprecation warning by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12050
* Make crossorigin property configurable for st.balloon, st.snow, and chat avatars by [USER] in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/12087

## New Contributors
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/9504
* [USER] made their first contribution in https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/pull/11901

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/compare/1.47.1...1.48.0
